part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `Node$PostOrderIterator.next()` (javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/Node.java:1163): when the root has no children, `fillStackToLeaf` leaves the stacks empty and `next()` immediately peeked them, throwing `EmptyStackException`.

The fix returns the root and sets `hasNext = false` when the stacks are empty, so a childless root yields itself exactly once — matching PREORDER behavior.

Verified: all 18 `NodeTest` tests (including the new `PostOrderIteratorTest` cases) pass, and the full `javaparser-core-testing` suite passes (2335 tests, 0 failures).
